items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: COM entry points add line, circle, arc, ellipse, lightweight polyline, rectangle, text and a single-loop hatch; get_entity_properties reads back line length, circle radius/area, polyline coordinates/length and hatch area.
items.scope_and_limits: Source reading only. Hatch accepts one outer loop from a point list (no islands/inner loops, no curved boundaries); no topology or general measurement tool. No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no output evidence for any drawing or measurement; hatch islands and topology are absent.

items.name: Transactions
items.basis: Each tool wraps its COM calls in StartUndoMark/EndUndoMark; draw_hatch deletes its boundary polyline if hatch creation fails; undo/redo tools exist.
items.scope_and_limits: No batch, preview, checkpoint or rollback. Source shows partial writes on reported failure: draw_line/circle/... add the entity and then apply layer/color; if styling raises, the entity stays in the drawing while the tool returns success=false with no handle (no cleanup). Arrays failing mid-loop leave earlier copies. undo/redo send 'UNDO 1'/'_.REDO' asynchronously, sleep command_delay and return success=True without checking that anything was undone (false success, cap 2). No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no behavioral evidence; undo/redo report success unverified; partial entities left on reported failure.

items.name: Security defaults
items.basis: Default transport is stdio; HTTP default bind 127.0.0.1; erase/new/open/close/save/send_command carry destructiveHint annotations; save refuses when CAD is not connected.
items.scope_and_limits: send_command (arbitrary CAD command-line input, which can reach SHELL/LISP) is enabled by default with no allowlist or opt-in; open/save accept any filesystem path and save overwrites silently; streamable-http has no authentication and the host is configurable via --host. These are demonstrated permission-scope defects (cap 2). No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: dangerous execution on by default, no path scope, unauthenticated HTTP; no adversarial evidence.

items.name: Long tasks
items.basis: All COM calls are serialized on one STA thread; transient COM errors retry for about 10 s; rotating log file; stdio misuse warning.
items.scope_and_limits: No cancellation; COMExecutor.submit waits on future.result() with no timeout, so a hung CAD blocks every tool; no crash recovery beyond reconnecting. No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no timeouts/cancellation and no behavioral evidence.

declared_contract: A Python FastMCP server (v2.0.0, 35 tools) that drives a running Windows CAD application (AutoCAD, GstarCAD/GCAD or ZWCAD) over COM via pywin32: draw primitives, text, single-loop hatch and aligned dimensions; list layers/entities and read entity properties by handle; screenshot the CAD window; handle-based edits and arrays; undo/redo; layers; new/open/close/save drawings (DWG/DXF claimed by extension); block definition/insert; raw command passthrough; a legacy natural-language parser. Transports: stdio and unauthenticated streamable-http. No headless or file-based backend.

GitHub Actions run 34955979173 (Dependency Graph, completed 2026-09-15): not a test run
No committed tests, results, logs or benchmarks exist in the repository

serious_defects.description: undo/redo send 'UNDO 1' / '_.REDO' through asynchronous SendCommand, sleep command_delay and return success=True without checking that the drawing changed (false success).

send_command passes arbitrary text to the CAD command line by default (no allowlist or opt-in), and the streamable-http transport has no authentication while its host is configurable; open/save accept any path and save overwrites silently.

limitations: Static source review only: the repository was not installed or run and no CAD was launched, per brief.
Behavior of SaveAs without a file type on each CAD (DXF vs DWG output) was not verified.
imgs/demo.gif was not traced to any commit and was not used as evidence.
Scores of 1 reflect code that exists without output evidence; they do not imply the code fails.
